items.summary: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 64% since late March 2026 on AI infrastructure demand. Broadcom reported Q1 AI revenue of $8.4B (+106% YoY) and guided Q2 to $10.7B, targeting $100B by 2027. CME launched GPU compute futures market May 12 to hedge against rising AI chip costs.

news.title: Broadcom Posts $8.4B Q1 AI Revenue, Guides $10.7B for Q2 with $100B 2027 Target
CME Launches Compute Futures Market for GPU Price Hedging

items.summary: U.S. secured 1.7 metric tons of HALEU from Japan on May 7, largest international uranium shipment in NNSA history. DOE awarded $94M to 8 companies for SMR deployment. NRC expedited licensing for advanced reactors; Bangladesh completed nuclear fuel loading May 13; Japan Airlines deployed humanoid robots for luggage handling using Unitree platforms May 2026.

news.title: U.S. Receives Largest HALEU Shipment from Japan—1.7 Metric Tons for Nuclear Industry
DOE Awards $94M to Accelerate Small Modular Reactor Deployment

items.summary: Trump administration released 2026 National Defense Strategy emphasizing hemispheric security and $150B additional DOD funding. U.S. Navy established three new Portfolio Acquisition Executive offices May 11 for Aviation, Mission Systems, and Munitions. Lockheed Martin awarded $407M for Aegis Guam System development with 2027 target for early operational capability.

news.title: 2026 National Defense Strategy Released with $150B Supplemental Funding
Navy Restructures Acquisition with New Portfolio Executive Offices

items.summary: Agentic AI adoption reached GPT-2.5 moment for enterprise; fewer than 10% of enterprises scaled agents to real value. Broadridge launched production-ready agentic capabilities May 13 for post-trade automation. Cognizant launched Secure AI Services May 7 to govern agentic systems; BCG projects $200B net new market from agentic AI by 2030.

news.title: Broadridge Announces Production-Ready Agentic Capabilities for Financial Services
Cognizant Launches Secure AI Services for Enterprise Agentic Systems

items.summary: CMS launched BALANCE Model for GLP-1 access starting May 2026 in Medicaid, January 2027 in Medicare Part D; July 2026 payment demo offers $50/month copay. GLP-1 user estimates project 25–30M Americans by 2030 vs. 10M in 2026. IQVIA dubbed 2026 'year of the orals' for GLP-1 formulations; Novo Nordisk reported Q1 2026 DKK 96.8B sales with GLP-1 focus.

news.title: CMS Launches BALANCE Model to Expand GLP-1 Access in Medicaid and Medicare
2026 Shaping Up as 'Year of the Orals' for Next-Gen GLP-1 Therapies

items.summary: Japan Airlines deployed humanoid robots at Tokyo Haneda Airport in May 2026 for three-year operational commitment—first legacy carrier deployment. Physical Intelligence's pi-0.7 (April 2026) performed unseen tasks; ~$6B flowed into world model companies Q1 2026. SoftBank acquired ABB Robotics for $5.4B; Bessemer called it 'GPT-2.5 moment for robotics' with 99.9% reliability gap remaining.

news.title: Japan Airlines Deploys Humanoid Robots at Haneda for Three-Year Commitment
SoftBank Acquires ABB Robotics for $5.4B to Lead Physical AI Frontier

items.summary: Copper designated critical mineral by USGS in 2025; U.S. secured 100,000 tons via African vehicle for domestic use, 50,000 for allies. J.P. Morgan expects 2.6% copper demand growth YoY; IEA projects 30% supply deficit by 2035. Copper hit record $14,500/tonne in January 2026, near all-time highs May 2026 amid AI data center demand.

news.title: Copper Added to USGS Critical Minerals List; U.S. Secures 100,000 Ton Supply
J.P. Morgan Projects 2.6% YoY Copper Demand Growth; Tight Market Expected in 2026

items.summary: Red Hat and Core42 announced sovereign cloud/AI collaboration May 11 for UAE public sector and defense. Canada and TELUS advancing sovereign AI data center in British Columbia May 11. Europe launched EURO-3C federated cloud/AI project (70+ orgs) at MWC; MIT Technology Review report (May 14) found AI/data sovereignty strongest predictor of enterprise AI success—70% of executives need sovereign platform.

news.title: Red Hat and Core42 Partner on Sovereign Cloud and AI Infrastructure for UAE
MIT Report: AI & Data Sovereignty Strongest Predictor of Enterprise AI Success
